title: Townsend Brown and the Caroline Group

tellings.quote: And then Townsend Brown also runs into this sort of, you know, the Caroline Group, this international group of industrialists that seem to suck up all of the exotic tech.

plain: Michels says that an American inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown ran into the Caroline Group, which he describes as an international group of industrialists who seemed to soak up all of the exotic technology. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. If true, it would mean unusual inventions were being gathered up by private money and kept out of public view.
